main.description: A dated note explaining why a person was blocked or muted, kept alongside the real app.bsky.graph.block record (for blocks) or the account-side mute (for mutes, which have no repo record of their own). One entry per (subject, kind) pair. Written and read by blocknotes (https://blocknotes.bisks.net).

subject.description: DID of the person this note is about.

subjectHandle.description: The handle subject resolved to at the time this note was written, kept for display/search without a re-lookup. May go stale if they change handles.

reason.description: Why — the reminder note. Written to your own public PDS repo like every atproto record; see notes/50-oauth-scopes.md and blocknotes' own privacy note for what that means.

createdAt.description: When the block/mute (and this note) was made, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
